column1: # Unit 7 — This, that, where, questions
这|zhè|this|这是我的手机。|Zhè shì wǒ de shǒujī.|This is my phone.
那|nà|that|那是什么？|Nà shì shénme?|What is that?
哪|nǎ|which|你要哪个？|Nǐ yào nǎ ge?|Which one do you want?
这些|zhèxiē|these|这些是我的书。|Zhèxiē shì wǒ de shū.|These are my books.
那些|nàxiē|those|那些人是谁？|Nàxiē rén shì shéi?|Who are those people?
哪些|nǎxiē|which ones|你喜欢哪些菜？|Nǐ xǐhuan nǎxiē cài?|Which dishes do you like?
这儿|zhèr|here|你来这儿。|Nǐ lái zhèr.|Come here.
那儿|nàr|there|我在那儿工作。|Wǒ zài nàr gōngzuò.|I work there.
哪儿|nǎr|where|你去哪儿？|Nǐ qù nǎr?|Where are you going?
这里|zhèlǐ|here|这里很漂亮。|Zhèlǐ hěn piàoliang.|It's beautiful here.
那里|nàlǐ|there|那里有很多人。|Nàlǐ yǒu hěn duō rén.|There are lots of people there.
哪里|nǎlǐ|where|洗手间在哪里？|Xǐshǒujiān zài nǎlǐ?|Where is the bathroom?
这边|zhèbiān|this side; over here|请这边走。|Qǐng zhèbiān zǒu.|This way, please.
那边|nàbiān|that side; over there|商店在那边。|Shāngdiàn zài nàbiān.|The store is over there.
边|biān|side|我坐你边上。|Wǒ zuò nǐ biān shang.|I'll sit beside you.
谁|shéi|who|他是谁？|Tā shì shéi?|Who is he?
怎么|zěnme|how; why|这个字怎么读？|Zhège zì zěnme dú?|How do you read this character?
怎么样|zěnmeyàng|how about; how is it|明天去怎么样？|Míngtiān qù zěnmeyàng?|How about going tomorrow?
# Unit 8 — Places & directions
上|shàng|up; on; last|书在桌子上。|Shū zài zhuōzi shang.|The book is on the table.
下|xià|down; under; next|猫在椅子下。|Māo zài yǐzi xià.|The cat is under the chair.
里|lǐ|inside|妈妈在房间里。|Māma zài fángjiān lǐ.|Mom is in the room.
外|wài|outside|外面很冷。|Wàimiàn hěn lěng.|It's cold outside.
外边|wàibian|outside|孩子们在外边玩。|Háizimen zài wàibian wán.|The kids are playing outside.
学校|xuéxiào|school|我们的学校很大。|Wǒmen de xuéxiào hěn dà.|Our school is very big.
大学|dàxué|university|她在大学学习。|Tā zài dàxué xuéxí.|She studies at university.
中学|zhōngxué|middle/high school|我弟弟上中学。|Wǒ dìdi shàng zhōngxué.|My younger brother is in high school.
小学|xiǎoxué|elementary school|我家前边有一个小学。|Wǒ jiā qiánbian yǒu yí ge xiǎoxué.|There's an elementary school in front of my home.
公司|gōngsī|company|我在公司工作。|Wǒ zài gōngsī gōngzuò.|I work at a company.
医院|yīyuàn|hospital|医院在哪儿？|Yīyuàn zài nǎr?|Where is the hospital?
商店|shāngdiàn|store|这个商店很大。|Zhège shāngdiàn hěn dà.|This store is very big.
店|diàn|shop|这家店卖什么？|Zhè jiā diàn mài shénme?|What does this shop sell?
超市|chāoshì|supermarket|我去超市买水果。|Wǒ qù chāoshì mǎi shuǐguǒ.|I'm going to the supermarket to buy fruit.
书店|shūdiàn|bookstore|书店在学校前边。|Shūdiàn zài xuéxiào qiánbian.|The bookstore is in front of the school.
电影院|diànyǐngyuàn|cinema|我们去电影院吧。|Wǒmen qù diànyǐngyuàn ba.|Let's go to the cinema.
房间|fángjiān|room|我的房间很小。|Wǒ de fángjiān hěn xiǎo.|My room is small.
# Unit 9 — Things
东西|dōngxi|thing; stuff|你买什么东西？|Nǐ mǎi shénme dōngxi?|What are you buying?
书|shū|book|这本书很好看。|Zhè běn shū hěn hǎokàn.|This book is good.
字|zì|character; word|这个字我不认识。|Zhège zì wǒ bú rènshi.|I don't know this character.
汉字|Hànzì|Chinese character|汉字很漂亮。|Hànzì hěn piàoliang.|Chinese characters are beautiful.
汉语|Hànyǔ|Chinese (language)|你会说汉语吗？|Nǐ huì shuō Hànyǔ ma?|Can you speak Chinese?
中文|Zhōngwén|Chinese (language)|我在学中文。|Wǒ zài xué Zhōngwén.|I'm learning Chinese.
课|kè|class; lesson|今天有汉语课。|Jīntiān yǒu Hànyǔ kè.|There's Chinese class today.
手机|shǒujī|cell phone|我的手机在哪儿？|Wǒ de shǒujī zài nǎr?|Where's my phone?
电话|diànhuà|telephone|你的电话！|Nǐ de diànhuà!|Your phone's ringing!
电脑|diànnǎo|computer|我用电脑工作。|Wǒ yòng diànnǎo gōngzuò.|I work on a computer.
电视|diànshì|television|我不喜欢看电视。|Wǒ bù xǐhuan kàn diànshì.|I don't like watching TV.
电影|diànyǐng|movie|我们去看电影吧。|Wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba.|Let's go see a movie.
衣服|yīfu|clothes|我想买新衣服。|Wǒ xiǎng mǎi xīn yīfu.|I want to buy new clothes.
桌子|zhuōzi|table; desk|桌子上有一个杯子。|Zhuōzi shang yǒu yí ge bēizi.|There's a cup on the table.
椅子|yǐzi|chair|请坐这把椅子。|Qǐng zuò zhè bǎ yǐzi.|Please sit on this chair.
车|chē|vehicle; car|这是我的车。|Zhè shì wǒ de chē.|This is my car.
出租车|chūzūchē|taxi|我们坐出租车吧。|Wǒmen zuò chūzūchē ba.|Let's take a taxi.
火车|huǒchē|train|我坐火车去北京。|Wǒ zuò huǒchē qù Běijīng.|I'm taking the train to Beijing.
飞机|fēijī|airplane|我坐飞机去中国。|Wǒ zuò fēijī qù Zhōngguó.|I'm flying to China.
事|shì|matter; thing to do|你有什么事？|Nǐ yǒu shénme shì?|What's up? / What do you need?
# Unit 10 — Describing things
大|dà|big|这个房间很大。|Zhège fángjiān hěn dà.|This room is big.
小|xiǎo|small|我的狗很小。|Wǒ de gǒu hěn xiǎo.|My dog is small.
新|xīn|new|这是新手机。|Zhè shì xīn shǒujī.|This is a new phone.
贵|guì|expensive|这个太贵了！|Zhège tài guì le!|This is too expensive!
便宜|piányi|cheap|这个很便宜。|Zhège hěn piányi.|This is cheap.
漂亮|piàoliang|pretty|你的衣服很漂亮。|Nǐ de yīfu hěn piàoliang.|Your clothes are pretty.
好看|hǎokàn|good-looking; good (to watch)|这个电影很好看。|Zhège diànyǐng hěn hǎokàn.|This movie is good.
好听|hǎotīng|nice to hear|这首歌很好听。|Zhè shǒu gē hěn hǎotīng.|This song is nice.
好玩儿|hǎowánr|fun|中国很好玩儿。|Zhōngguó hěn hǎowánr.|China is a lot of fun.
忙|máng|busy|你忙吗？|Nǐ máng ma?|Are you busy?
冷|lěng|cold|今天很冷。|Jīntiān hěn lěng.|It's cold today.
热|rè|hot|今天太热了。|Jīntiān tài rè le.|It's too hot today.
病|bìng|illness; sick|他病了。|Tā bìng le.|He's sick.
生病|shēng bìng|to get sick|我生病了。|Wǒ shēng bìng le.|I got sick.
看病|kàn bìng|to see a doctor|我下午去看病。|Wǒ xiàwǔ qù kàn bìng.|I'm seeing a doctor this afternoon.
天气|tiānqì|weather|今天天气怎么样？|Jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?|How's the weather today?
雨|yǔ|rain|雨很大。|Yǔ hěn dà.|The rain is heavy.
下雨|xià yǔ|to rain|明天会下雨。|Míngtiān huì xià yǔ.|It will rain tomorrow.
雪|xuě|snow|北京冬天会下雪。|Běijīng dōngtiān huì xià xuě.|It snows in Beijing in winter.
# Unit 11 — Adverbs & particles
都|dōu|all; both|我们都是学生。|Wǒmen dōu shì xuésheng.|We are all students.
太|tài|too; extremely|太好了！|Tài hǎo le!|Great!
非常|fēicháng|extremely|我非常喜欢中国菜。|Wǒ fēicháng xǐhuan Zhōngguó cài.|I really love Chinese food.
真|zhēn|really|你真好！|Nǐ zhēn hǎo!|You're so kind!
再|zài|again|请再说一遍。|Qǐng zài shuō yí biàn.|Please say it once more.
还|hái|still; also|我还没吃饭。|Wǒ hái méi chī fàn.|I haven't eaten yet.
正在|zhèngzài|in the middle of (doing)|我正在吃饭。|Wǒ zhèngzài chī fàn.|I'm eating right now.
对|duì|correct; toward|你说得对。|Nǐ shuō de duì.|You're right.
和|hé|and; with|我和妈妈去超市。|Wǒ hé māma qù chāoshì.|Mom and I are going to the supermarket.
了|le|(change / completed action)|我吃了。|Wǒ chī le.|I've eaten.
吧|ba|(suggestion particle)|我们走吧。|Wǒmen zǒu ba.|Let's go.
